excerpt: Multi-agent systems fail in ways traditional monitoring misses. This post presents a dual-layer approach to monitoring production agents: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations for continuous quality scoring and AWS DevOps Agent for autonomous infrastructure investigation, shown on a four-agent airline reservation system.
